description: Search the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) real-time seismicity catalog (EMSC-RTS) by time range, bounding box or point+radius, magnitude range, and depth range. A distinct regional network from USGS, often lower-latency for Euro-Mediterranean events, with per-event reporting-agency attribution. Returns event ID, time, magnitude, location, depth, region name, and reporting agency for each match. Data: seismicportal.eu (EMSC), no auth required.

endtime.description: End of the time window, ISO 8601 date or datetime (e.g. 2026-08-27T23:59:59). Omit for no upper bound.

latitude.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees for a point+radius search (use with longitude and maxradius).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, 1-200 (default 50).

longitude.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees for a point+radius search (use with latitude and maxradius).

maxlatitude.description: Maximum latitude in decimal degrees for a bounding-box search (e.g. 45.0).

maxlongitude.description: Maximum longitude in decimal degrees for a bounding-box search (e.g. 25.0).

maxradius.description: Search radius in degrees around the latitude/longitude point (e.g. 5 for ~550km at the equator).

minlatitude.description: Minimum latitude in decimal degrees for a bounding-box search (e.g. 34.0).

minlongitude.description: Minimum longitude in decimal degrees for a bounding-box search (e.g. 5.0).

starttime.description: Start of the time window, ISO 8601 date or datetime (e.g. 2026-08-01 or 2026-08-01T00:00:00). Omit for no lower bound.

name: emsc.seismic.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search EMSC Real-Time Earthquakes
